title: A formally smooth complete local algebra over the residue field lifts to a formally smooth complete local algebra
statement: Let $(A_0,\mathfrak m_0)$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local ring which is $\mathfrak m_0$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], with residue field $k_0=A_0/\mathfrak m_0$. Let $(E,\mathfrak m_E)$ be a Noetherian local ring which is $\mathfrak m_E$-adically complete, together with a ring homomorphism $k_0\to E$, such that $E$ is formally smooth over $k_0$ for the $\mathfrak m_E$-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic]; regard $E$ as an $A_0$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient] through $A_0\to k_0\to E$. Then there exist a Noetherian local ring $(C,\mathfrak m_C)$ which is $\mathfrak m_C$-adically complete, a local homomorphism $\gamma:A_0\to C$ ($\gamma(\mathfrak m_0)\subseteq\mathfrak m_C$) such that $C$ is formally smooth over $A_0$ for the $\mathfrak m_C$-adic topology, and a ring isomorphism $\sigma:C/\mathfrak m_0C\xrightarrow{\sim}E$ which is a homomorphism of $A_0$-algebras, where $\mathfrak m_0C$ is the ideal of $C$ generated by $\gamma(\mathfrak m_0)$ and $C/\mathfrak m_0C$ is an $A_0$-algebra through $\gamma$; that is, $\sigma(\gamma(a)\bmod\mathfrak m_0C)$ is the image of $a\bmod\mathfrak m_0$ in $E$ for every $a\in A_0$.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07NR (lemma-lift-fs, line 10256), with $A_0$, $E$ in the roles of the source's $A$, $B$; the source writes $C\otimes_Ak\cong B$, and its proof (the diagram of Lemma Tag 07NN, lemma-embed-map-Noetherian-complete-local-rings, for the local homomorphism $A\to k\to B$, then $C=S\otimes_RA$ with $C\otimes_Ak=S\otimes_Rk=\overline S=B$) gives this isomorphism compatibly with the maps from $A$, as stated here. Formal smoothness 'in the $\mathfrak m_C$-adic topology' is Definition Tag 07NI (definition-formally-smooth-adic, line 9213), the condition of def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic.
